about_the_game:
Bite the Crown casts players as a sentient mold, an anomaly born in the depths of a packaging factory, seeking to overthrow the ruthless Snack King. To dismantle the tyrannical regime, you must build and lead a covert rebel organization, recruiting oppressed snacks and orchestrating daring missions to weaken the kingdom from within.

BUILD YOUR RESISTANCE

Gather and manage resources to expand your secret hideout, transforming it into a fully operational resistance base. Recruit discarded, expired, and rebellious snacks, assigning them to critical missions that sabotage the king’s supply chains, infiltrate factories, and rescue imprisoned allies before they’re sealed away forever. Strengthen your movement by upgrading specialized weapons, developing intelligence networks, and striking where the enemy least expects it.

CRUSH THE KING’S FORCES

Venture into the Snack Kingdom’s sprawling, ever-changing districts, where the king’s enforcers and mechanized food warriors patrol the land. Use your agility, combat prowess, and unpredictable nature to fight back against waves of loyalist forces, dismantling the regime one battle at a time. Take down the king’s high-ranking officers, absorb their secrets, and turn their power against them as you carve a path toward the throne.

SPREAD THE ROT

Expand your influence across the kingdom by carrying out high-stakes missions, toppling supply routes, and turning factory workers into operatives of the cause. Unravel the dark secrets behind the Snack King’s rule and awaken the oppressed to the reality of their world. Will you have what it takes to erode the empire and take a bite out of the crown?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS 11 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7-9750H or more
  • Graphics: Radeon Pro 5300M 4GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7-9750H or more

short_description: In a world where crunchy chips and sugary treats reign supreme, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Mold. Born in the forgotten corners of a snack empire, this humble mold is ready to tear down the walls of tyranny and lead a revolution against the snack oligarchy!
